notes: ἵνα μήποτε is split, *Lest* going to the conjunction that introduces the English clause under rule 40 and *haply* to the particle; taking *Lest haply* whole on μήποτε with an unrepresented ἵνα remains defensible, but rule 40 permits an unrepresented conjunction only under rule 37.
The expressed genitive subject αὐτοῦ of the absolute takes the English subject word under rule 74, the participle keeping the subordinator and auxiliary.
